Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that's it from the coverage of this game. Both the skipper's now are called up, and they pose together with the trophy as the T20I series ends in a 2-2 draw. Soon, all the players of the both the side join as well, and put in a smile for the cameras. The next assignment for these two sides is a 5-match ODI series. New format, but there will be no compromise in the quality of cricket. The first ODI will be played on 27th April. The first ball will be at 4 pm IST (10.30 am GMT), but you can join us early for the build-up. Until then, take care and goodbye!

Tom Latham, the skipper of New Zealand says that he is happy with the win and really happy with how Chapman played. Adds that it was a crucial partnership, and Neesham supported him really well. He says that it was a great chase and they adapted to the conditions really well. He ends by saying that it feels good to level the series from 2-0 down and they will look forward to the ODI series as well.

Babar Azam, the captain of Pakistan says that the way they started it looked like 200 was possible and feels that they were 10-15 runs short. Tells that the way Ifti has improved his batting, also credits Imad as well who chipped in with the bat. Mentions both these players have been working on themselves, and have performed well in the PSL as well. Praises Chapman for his outstanding knock. Adds that if someone plays an innings like that, no one can do much to stop it. Informs that ODI is a different type of cricket, but as professional he feels that the boys are ready and they will try to win the series.

Mark Chapman wins the Player of the Match award for his match-winning knock. He is also adjudged as the PLAYER OF THE SERIES for his consistency with the blade throughout the series. He says that it was very special for him and all played really well. He adds that it was a bit difficult to adjust to these kinds of pitches, but it ended well for them. Says that he is thankful to Neesham for supporting him with the bat and ends by saying that he is really happy to win the game.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the game, after being put to bat, Pakistan got off to a flier, tahnks to their opening stand. It was a batters deck and they made the most of it. Although, once the opening stand was broken, it kind of opened the floodgates for the hosts. If not for Mohammad Rizwan, Pakistan couldn't have reached anywhere near the 190-run mark. For Kiwis, Blair Tickner stood out with the ball earlier for his three-wicket haul.

Daryl Mitchell and Mark Chapman then tried to get their inning back on track with their 47-run stand, but Mitchell slipped out at a very crucial stage to make it 73-4. Then it was just the begininng of the downfall of this Pakistan bowling performance, as the hosts lost all confidence, while they were being taken apart by the hard-hitters of the Kiwis. Mark Chapman was literally toying with the bowlers and scored a match-winning knock of 104* runs to get his side over the line. Although, this wouldn't have been possible without James Neesham, who supported well with his brisk 25-ball 45. These two stitched a stand of 121 runs to steer the team home. Pakistan will be gutted with their effort with the ball. In the end, it was just a bad day at the office for them, as they could not seal the series.

New Zealand had no right to win this game, with the way their chase started, but Mark Chapman, who has been consistent for them throughout this series, put his hand up once again and the rest as they say is history. New Zealand were put on the back foot straighaway. It was Shaheen Afridi who caused all the issues for the visitors with the new ball, when he took two wickets in the very first over of the chase. Imad Wasim then continued to strangle the batters and chipped in with an early wicket of Chad Bowes. New Zealand had lost three wickets inside just 4 overs.

OH MY GOD! A humdinger of a cricket match. The pendulum swung relentlessly both ways, but once Neesham and Chapman joined forces, there was no stopping the Kiwis. The visitors managed to chase down 194 with 4 balls to spare, this is also the second highest chase by any side against Pakistan in T20Is. On top of all that, New Zealand level the series as well!
NEW ZEALAND HAVE DONE IT! On a length and on off, Mark Chapman flicks it to mid-wicket for a quick couple of runs. Incredible chase from New Zealand as they beat Pakistan by 6 wickets!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Consecutive boundries now. Gets a bit fortunate this time. It is fuller, on middle. Chad Bowes goes for the flick, but it catches the leading edge. The ball loops over backward point and races away once again. This outfield is quick.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Shaheen Afridi to Chad Bowes, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Incredible shot. Shaheen Afridi serves it full, on middle. Chad Bowes clears his front leg and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Shaheen Afridi to Chad Bowes, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Full length, on off. Bowes toe ends it to mid on, off his front foot.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Shaheen Afridi to Chad Bowes, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Short ball, on middle and leg. Chad Bowes goes for the pull shot. It comes off his inner half, but the ball still manages to race away to the deep square leg fence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Shaheen Afridi to Chad Bowes, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, on leg. Bowes knocks it to mid on off the inner half. Good-looking shot but finds the fielder.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Shaheen Afridi to Chad Bowes, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: A dot to end the over! It is an arm ball, on leg. Daryl Mitchell gets pinged on his pads. Mohammad Rizwan pleads from behind the sticks but Wasim informs him that it is going down leg, as the umpire is unmoved.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Imad Wasim to Daryl Mitchell, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Floated and full, on leg. Bowes uses his feet and flicks it to long on for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Imad Wasim to Chad Bowes, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Wasim follows the batter down leg. Bowes pushes it down the ground to mid off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Imad Wasim to Chad Bowes, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: On off, blocked out.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Imad Wasim to Chad Bowes, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Daryl Mitchell pushes this full ball to mid off and scampers across for a quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Imad Wasim to Daryl Mitchell, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Chad Bowes finally comes on strike. Fuller, on leg. Bowes clips it to wide of long on for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Imad Wasim to Chad Bowes, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Imad Wasim will bowl from the other end.
Very full, on off. Daryl Mitchell dabs it out to mid off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Shaheen Afridi to Daryl Mitchell, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Daryl Mitchell walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Shaheen Afridi has the last laugh here and the signature celebration comes out again. Shaheen Afridi serves a length ball, around off, angled across. It straightens a touch. Will Young shuffles and tries to defend it out, but only manages to feather it behind towards the keeper. Mohammad Rizwan there makes no mistake. New Zealand on the back foot right inside the first over of this chase.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Shaheen Afridi
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Shaheen Afridi to Will Young, OUT! c Mohammad Rizwan b Shaheen Afridi.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! What a shot. Will Young gets off the mark with a boundary. Much fuller, outside off. Will Young prods and crunches it along the ground, through the gap at covers for a boundary. This should give him confidence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Shaheen Afridi to Will Young, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller this time, on off, nipping in a touch. Young gets on his front foot and punches it into covers.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Shaheen Afridi to Will Young, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Shaheen Afridi nails his yorker this time, on off. Young gets his blade down in time and deals with it.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Shaheen Afridi to Will Young, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Will Young walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shaheen Afridi draws first blood instantly, off his very first delivery. Shaheen Afridi certainly loves to pick wickets in the very first over. It is a length ball, outside off, swinging away. Tom Latham gets enticed into chasing it but only manages to get an outside edge on it. The ball flies to point, where Shadab Khan takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Shadab Khan b Shaheen Afridi
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Shaheen Afridi to Tom Latham, OUT! c Shadab Khan b Shaheen Afridi.
